jags: Updates one node at a time, as in Gibbs sampling, with conjugate samplers where it recognizes them and slice or Metropolis steps otherwise
stan: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, in its No-U-Turn form (NUTS)

jags: A BUGS-style description of a graphical model; the order of the statements does not matter
stan: A typed program in blocks (`data`, `parameters`, `model`); the statements run in order and accumulate the log density
Not allowed; they are summed out of the joint density
Translated to C++ and compiled before sampling

jags: `Rhat` and effective sample size, computed from the draws with the `coda` package
stan: `Rhat` and effective sample size, plus sampler checks such as divergent transitions and tree depth
